sources.quote: We will dynamically pass cost savings back to you, providing the same 75% token discount.
sources.supports: Google announced that Gemini 2.5 implicit cache hits received a 75% discount; on $0.30 input that corresponds to $0.075 per million cached tokens, matching the earlier recorded rate.

sources.quote: Context caching price | Not available | $0.03 (text / image / video) $0.1 (audio) $1.00 / 1,000,000 tokens per hour (storage price)
sources.supports: Google's current Gemini 2.5 Flash Standard pricing table lists $0.03 per million cached text, image, or video tokens.

notes: The official May 2025 announcement supports the earlier $0.075 cache-read rate as a 75% discount on $0.30 input, while Google's current pricing page lists $0.03, so this is a provider price change. Google does not state the change date on the fetched page; the Internet Archive CDX request returned HTTP 503, so there is no defensible effective date or snapshot bracket.
